LoloBuy QC Photos: A Practical Inspection Checklist

Start with the order record

Save the selected colour, size, quantity and seller description before comparing warehouse images. A product photo is a reference, not evidence of the item that arrived.

Inspect the visible details

Check the overall item, label, seams and any visible damage. For shoes inspect both sides and the sole; for clothing compare the measurement method and size chart. For electronics check the model and visible accessories without assuming that a photo proves operation.

Ask a precise question

If a detail changes your decision, request a clear view of that exact area or a measurement with both endpoints and units visible. Review any fee and conditions in the live account before confirming a request.

Decide before shipping

Photographs cannot prove fit, authenticity, materials or durability. Keep the order and images together, report a mismatch while the item is still in the warehouse, and check the current return terms before approving a parcel.
